decision.reason: [ev-a3ced82c8829] is an umbrella "Backwards Compatibility with v1" section, not one change. Its general part only says there is "a set of breaking changes" to long-deprecated and long-alpha features. The change text then bundles several separate removals: native patch-and-transform (`mode: Resources`), `ControllerConfig` (replaced by `DeploymentRuntimeConfig`), and more items that are cut off. So no single subject, change, applicability or consequence can be written from it. To write typed assertions, each listed removal needs its own complete evidence, and the full untruncated list is needed.
